pixelFrame: Original distorted 960x540 extracted source images, top-left origin
meaning: Manual identification polygons for visible public-facing surfaces only. Not room footprints, physical dimensions, tenancy rear boundaries, or world-placement controls. Cabinets, flowers and displays remain dated observed contents.
manualOcclusionMeaning: Source-image-inspected human/occluded counter regions. Conservative triangle projection bounding-box overlap subtracts these rays from the component union, including missed bottle-counter staff. Hidden background is not filled; some valid surfaces behind people are deliberately withheld.
selectionRule: Observed-texture triangle centroid must project into a named original-image polygon AND be the first intersected surface from that calibrated camera. Union across two views, then subtract conservative manual human/occlusion ray regions. No depth extrapolation, solidification, hole filling or hidden rear faces.
